#

# in garden.gno's own "WHAT v7 IS" block and in DESIGN.md; that list is not duplicated here,
# because two copies of it is how one of them goes stale. Two warnings are repeated, though,
# because they are the load-bearing half: a named-edition GUARANTEE was written 2026-10-17 and
# REMOVED 2026-10-18 (AUDIT-01 RED-1) with nothing in its place -- and v5 survived an audit, v6
# was a surgical copy, so ANYTHING beyond those ten changes is unreviewed.
#
# (Hard 4096-byte toolchain limit; `gno test` refuses a longer file. Detail is in garden.gno.)
#
# Checklist before deploying. 0-6 are v5's, 7-9 are v6's -- still outstanding after three
# versions -- and 10-14 are v7's.
#

#      gnotchi-opponent key we hold. RE-DECIDE FOR MAINNET: a test key is the wrong recipient
#      for real money, and a 1 GNOT floor exceeds 5% on any sale under 20.
#  (1) adminAddress is the onyx key `gnotchi-deploy`. Change it for anywhere real; there is no
#      admin-transfer function, by design.
#  (2) imports beacon/v2 from the OTHER namespace (g1r4aw43...), as v5/v6 do -- that import
#      works and must not be "fixed"; cannot deploy where it is not live.
#  (3) numEyes/numNoses/hat/coat catalogue must match the art side exactly.
#  (4) batchCap (60) and the roster hob/thistle/wick/tally/glim/vigil/spruce/yonder are

#      reservedNameKeys, and List's lock message says "eight" -- FOUR edits, not three.
#  (5) lockCaredDays SETTLED 2026-10-19 at 14 (was 30). Pinned by its own test; the two List
#      tests are value-agnostic.
#  (6) genesisGnomeName RE-SETTLED 2026-10-20: Gaffer (was Sprig, v7). Canonical form lives in
#      reservedNameKeys AND the character slug, which the realm asserts must equal the name.
#  (7) maxNameLen (24) must equal app/js/config.js's NAME_MAX_LEN. Hand-maintained.
#  (8) renaming allowed, names unique: the SHAPE of SetName and nameOwner, not constants.
#  (9) combining-mark exclusion: open product question (NOTES.md, v4 Y7). Mainnet, not onyx.
# (10) THE BADGER: APPROVED 2026-10-19, reasoning in TRAITS.md 8. Secrets 1 and 4 aim at it and

#      stale-claim sweep: each puts a permanent hole in the acrostic.
# (14) the seed derivation changed, so a given (round, claimant) does NOT produce v5's or v6's
#      gnome. seedDomain must never be edited after deploy: changing it re-rolls everybody.
#
# MUST NOT use the arcade/... prefix (ARCADE.md 4.7, NOTES.md).
module = "gno.land/r/g1nq99m3h9ed7vqve6ajpr3qwy2ls252m8jnundm/garden/v8"

package game32

// ── Claim-rate skill headroom factors (game29 caps, §5 of REPORT.md) ─────────
// When on-chain skillRanks are available these are computed from actual ranks.
// Until then we use fixed conservative headroom = client-side cap maximums.
// The effective rate for rarity r = base_rate[r] × skillHeadroom[r].
const (
	// dust: +4 yield cap, double drop and hardening -> sim max 1.70x of the 1.01 cap; 1.75 gives margin.
	skillDustHeadroom = uint64(175) // ×175/100

	// Maximum damage multiplier: ≤ 2× → twice as many blocks per minute.
	skillDmgHeadroom = uint64(200) // ×200/100

	// Maximum drop-rate bonus: +30% → 1.30×.
	skillDropHeadroom = uint64(130) // ×130/100
)

// toolLifeSkillIds lists the on-chain skills that grant toolLifeBonus.
// Covers the Things branch (level 50) and the Nature-branch skills that also
// affect tool wear. Must stay in sync with catalog.ts SKILLS[*].toolLifeBonus.
var toolLifeSkillIds = []string{
	"tempered_grip",   // +10%/rank   (Things)
	"stone_sense",     // +0.5%/rank  (Nature)
	"master_craft",    // +15%/rank   (Things)
	"thorn_hide",      // +1%/rank    (Nature)
	"storm_surge",     // +1.5%/rank  (Nature)
	"workshop_lore",   // +15%/rank   (Things)
	"iron_discipline", // +20%/rank   (Things)
	"vault_keeper",    // +20%/rank   (Things)
	"precision_forge", // +25%/rank   (Things)
	"field_repair",    // +10%/rank   (Things)
	"deep_science",    // +25%/rank   (Things)
}

// toolLifeSkillBonus maps each skill to its per-rank life bonus fraction × 1000.
// e.g. "tempered_grip" → 100 means +10.0% per rank (100/1000 = 0.10).
var toolLifeSkillBonus = map[string]uint64{
	"tempered_grip":   100, // +10%/rank
